digest.component_or_area: outbound link emission and mutation builders
propositions: A config-driven link-relation mapping must apply the same effective link_map to both ADD and REMOVE paths via a unified _resolve_link resolver.
Skip directives must be symmetric: a 'skip' override suppresses both ADD emission and REMOVE emission for that relation, never emitting an approximate link.
REMOVE attribution must be config-aware: a remote link carrying an overridden vendor type is recovered via inverted link_map rather than dropped, and its remove targets that overridden type.
Undeclared link types must fail closed by invoking validate() with Capability.has_link_types, raising MappingConfigError if a link_map value falls outside declared link_types vocabulary.
The effective_link_map seam must unify both jira and jira_datacenter backend consumers, preserving built-in swap semantics while allowing config override of link_type only.
With no [mapping] block, link emission must remain byte-for-byte identical to current behavior.
